service_description: Walk-in withdrawal management for alcohol and drugs. Bed-based detox.
bypass_pathway: If no beds, ask for day treatment referral. Say you need withdrawal support.
intake_preparation: Arrive with any medications. Intake takes 30 min. You will be assessed by a nurse.

service_description: Mental health crisis stabilization. Short-term bed-based support.
bypass_pathway: If full, ask for community mental health referral. CAMH accepts walk-ins 24/7.
intake_preparation: Tell intake you are in crisis. You will see a social worker within 2 hours.

service_description: 24/7 crisis services. Assessment and stabilization.
bypass_pathway: If turned away, try St. Joseph or Toronto Western ER psych.
intake_preparation: Walk in and say you need crisis support. No referral needed.

service_description: Mental health and addiction residential program.
bypass_pathway: Waitlist is common. Ask for interim housing referral while waiting.
intake_preparation: Bring any ID you have. Income support documents helpful but not required.

service_description: Residential addiction treatment and withdrawal management.
bypass_pathway: Call before arriving — bed availability changes daily.
intake_preparation: Residential 21-day program. Bring 2 weeks of clothing. No valuables.

service_description: Outpatient mental health and addiction counselling.
bypass_pathway: Long waitlist for therapy. Ask for drop-in counselling instead.
intake_preparation: First appointment is an intake assessment. Can take 90 minutes.

organization_name: Centre for Addiction and Mental Health
service_description: Full-spectrum addiction and mental health services.
bypass_pathway: If detox beds full, ask for medically supervised detox alternatives.
intake_preparation: Medical intake required. Bring health card if you have one.

service_description: Women-specific recovery home. Long-term residential support.
bypass_pathway: Only accepts women and non-binary persons. Call intake first.
intake_preparation: Interview required. Sober living environment — abstinence based.

service_description: Addiction counselling and harm reduction services.
bypass_pathway: Walk-in counselling Tuesdays 9 AM - 12 PM.
intake_preparation: Bring referral if you have one, but not required.

service_description: Community mental health support and case management.
bypass_pathway: If no space, ask for referral to other ACT teams.
intake_preparation: Regular office hours. Drop-in assessment on Mondays.

service_description: Harm reduction and primary health for marginalized communities.
bypass_pathway: No appointment needed for harm reduction services.
intake_preparation: ID not required. Ask for harm reduction nurse directly.

service_description: Indigenous men's shelter and mental health crisis support.
bypass_pathway: Primarily serves Indigenous men. Others referred to other services.
intake_preparation: Cultural safety practices in place. Smudging available.

service_description: Holistic health services for Indigenous peoples. Addiction support.
bypass_pathway: Open to all Indigenous peoples regardless of status.
intake_preparation: Traditional healing alongside clinical services.

service_description: Community health and addiction services.
bypass_pathway: If no beds, refer to CAMH or St. Joseph's.
intake_preparation: Bring any medications. Intake by nurse practitioner.

service_description: Harm reduction and community mental health services.
bypass_pathway: Drop-in harm reduction daily 9 AM - 4 PM.
intake_preparation: No ID required. Naloxone available at reception.

service_description: Mental health and addiction counselling.
bypass_pathway: Call for appointment. Long waitlist for therapy — ask for drop-in.
intake_preparation: Assessment first visit. Sliding scale fees if applicable.

service_description: Comprehensive men's shelter with addiction and mental health services.
bypass_pathway: If crisis beds full, ER at St. Michael's Hospital is 5 min walk.
intake_preparation: Tell intake if you are in acute withdrawal — priority placement.

service_description: Recovery home for adults with addiction.
bypass_pathway: Wait period can be 2-4 weeks. Ask about interim housing.
intake_preparation: Interview required. Bring 2 forms of ID.

service_description: Women's addiction recovery. Residential and day treatment.
bypass_pathway: Women and non-binary. Childcare available for mothers.
intake_preparation: Children can stay with mothers during treatment.

service_description: Harm reduction, counselling, and peer support.
bypass_pathway: Walk-in harm reduction. Naloxone, clean supplies available.
intake_preparation: No ID needed. Ask for peer support worker specifically.

service_description: North York addiction and mental health counselling.
bypass_pathway: Walk-in hours Thursdays. Call for regular appointments.
intake_preparation: Assessment appointment lasts 1 hour.

service_description: Mental health crisis support for Scarborough.
bypass_pathway: If crisis beds full, Scarborough General ER is adjacent.
intake_preparation: Walk-in triage. Wait times can be 2-4 hours for non-acute cases.

service_description: Outpatient addiction counselling and day programs.
bypass_pathway: Call for availability. Walk-in assessment Wednesdays.
intake_preparation: Intake assessment is free. Insurance or OHIP may cover treatment.

service_description: Community mental health residential support.
bypass_pathway: Long waitlist. Ask about supported housing alternatives.
intake_preparation: OHIP required for residential services.

service_description: Walk-in withdrawal management and harm reduction.
bypass_pathway: No ID required. Methadone and buprenorphine available.
intake_preparation: If using opioids, ask about same-day suboxone start.
